about: Adds FortiClient VPN connections to Nexus → Network. Each connection keeps its server, user and password (the password never goes into your shell settings), and you connect from the VPN icon in the bar, with a one-time code when the server asks for it.
highlights: One-time codes, client certificates and a health check that closes a dead tunnel after suspend
Several connections, one connected at a time
Export and import your connections, with passwords encrypted by a passphrase if you want them
Needs administrator rights once, to install its helper
author: iMacnucintosh

changes: Declares the Sylphrena version it needs
